input: Order a DNA ancestry kit as a gift for mom

gold.taskTitle: Order a DNA Ancestry Kit Gift for Mom
gold.taskDescription: Find and order a DNA ancestry kit to be given as a gift to the user's mother.

questions.title: Which DNA ancestry brand are you considering, if any?
questions.description: Identify whether the user has a preferred brand such as AncestryDNA, 23andMe, MyHeritage, or is open to recommendations.

questions.title: What is your budget for this kit?
questions.description: Determine the price range the user is comfortable spending to narrow down product options.

questions.title: What specific features matter most to your mom?
questions.description: Clarify whether the priority is ethnicity breakdown, health reports, relative matching, geographic migration history, or something else.

questions.title: When does she need to receive the gift by?
questions.description: Establish the delivery deadline to determine whether standard or expedited shipping is required.

questions.title: Should the kit be shipped directly to her or to you?
questions.description: Determine the delivery address to understand whether gift wrapping or a personal hand-off is part of the plan.

questions.title: Do you want a physical kit, a digital gift card, or either?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred format, since some brands offer e-gift cards that the recipient redeems for a physical kit.

questions.title: Is this tied to a specific occasion such as a birthday?
questions.description: Understand the occasion to factor in timing, any gift messaging needs, and whether special packaging matters.
